name: Deel
summary: Deel employs your hires through its own entities so you can pay people in a country where you have no company. Its employer of record plan starts at $599 per employee per month on month-to-month terms, and the vendor says local compliance, payroll and benefits administration are included in the quote.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Deel's global payroll page says payroll runs in 150+ countries, applies local tax rules and statutory requirements, and tracks status, variances and gross-to-net calculations across all countries and worker types.
Deel's pricing page lists no price for global payroll alone, only for contractors, EOR and US PEO, so the payroll cost comes from a demo quote.
Deel's EOR page cites 150+ countries for hiring and 130+ countries for owned entities and its payroll engine.
Deel says its team includes 200+ legal experts who cover employment regulations and tax laws by country.
Deel's pricing page describes month-to-month pricing with no long-term commitment for EOR, and lists no deposit or termination fee.
A US PEO order form with a minimum two-year term earns three months of platform fee credit, but ending early means paying list price for the whole term, credit included.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Listed as a starting price. Month-to-month with no long-term commitment.

hiddenCosts: The $599 is a starting price, so the quoted rate for a given country may be higher.
Currency exchange is described as carrying minimal fees, with no figure published.

contract.cancellation: The pricing page says there are no long-term commitments and that you can cancel at any time.
